ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (19) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Устройство» (ustroystvo, 'arrangement') is kept the same for the world and for society throughout the day; «усовершенствование» (usovershenstvovanie) of society is 'improvement' (TERMINOLOGY). In Henry George's Gospel citation «правды его» (pravdy ego) is 'his justice', the sense his argument requires, and Chrysostom's «единение» (edinenie) is 'union'; his unquoted 'Show us, they say…' stays unquoted.
